title: Transfer: Alert Routing Policy Translation
goal: Translate a Python incident alert routing module into idiomatic Scala 2.13, preserving escalation behavior while recasting severity levels, channels, schedules, and fallback logic into immutable Scala models with exhaustive pattern matching.
skillBenefitRationale: This tests whether the learner can apply python-scala-idioms in an operations-policy setting, replacing Python branching and nullable lookups with sealed ADTs, Options, and composable transformations as the only essential competency.
